veranderings.voor: wat oor 'n tafelrand uitsteek ook dat
veranderings.na: wat oor 'n tafelrand uitsteek, ook dat
veranderings.rede: A comma closing the embedded relative clause stops 'uitsteek ook dat' reading as one run and is allowed by the AWS to mark off a subordinate clause.

veranderings.blok: Hoekom die een trom laer klink as die ander
veranderings.voor: dieselfde vel stywer of slapper trek
veranderings.na: dieselfde vel stywer of slapper span
veranderings.rede: 'span' is the usual verb for a drumskin and matches 'gespan' used for the same action in the list block, so the learner meets one word for one thing.

vlae.teks: Die sand of klein klippies binne die kokonratels ratel wanneer die danser beweeg.
vlae.rede: The protected entry for 'kokonratels' says the compound is always introduced in full first ('ratels van gedroogde kokonne'), but in this lesson it appears without that introduction; a language agent cannot add it, so the writer should check whether it is needed here.
